Boulder Scientific Company, LLC | Revolver | N/A | 1/7/2025 | 12/31/2027 | $ - | $( 1 ) | $ - | (2)(6)(9)

findings.detail: PP03 misidentifies current-period schedule rows as comparative-period rows when the same instrument also appears in the prior-period schedule.

rationale: The filing contents identify schedules for both March 31, 2026 and December 31, 2025. The flagged Boulder Scientific revolver is printed in table 11 within the current-period schedule sequence, which closes with the explicit Total Investments, March 31, 2026 line at table 28 row 7. A corresponding prior-period row at table 31 does not make the table 11 row comparative. The extracted current-period position is therefore source-supported and the PP03 period-purity warning is a false alarm caused by bad period anchoring/rule scope.
